import sys

def merge_words(words):
    result = words[0]
    for word in words[1:]:
        overlap = 0
        for i in range(1, min(len(result), len(word)) + 1):
            if result[-i:] == word[:i]:
                overlap = i
        result += word[overlap:]
    return result

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
words = input[1:]
print(merge_words(words))
